decisions.reason: Its proven use by a named government customer and broad connectivity to APIS schemes make it a core, credible part of our aviation and border-security portfolio.
Cyber security awareness training fits our training-led model, can be sold across existing accounts, and meets steadily rising client demand with limited delivery risk.
Passenger security profiling remains the weakest product on visible traction and carries the highest regulatory, reputational, and customer-acceptance risk in our German and European markets.
The document verification platform is close to our core offer, supports transport and border-related customers directly, and complements our wider security and compliance solutions.
